confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from the RBA search result, dated 18 Nov 2026, and the figure was not read from the RBA table directly. I ran one search for Querétaro prices, which returned crowdsourced cost-of-living indexes. These put a cheap meal at about $6-11, a domestic beer at about $2-2.50 and a cappuccino at about $2-3.7. Mid-range meal estimates for two ranged widely, from about $28 to $64. The cocktail and wine figures are not from direct sources. I set cocktail at about 2.5x the beer price and wine at about 2x, based on typical Mexican restaurant relationships. The accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not search for them or inspect any listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized Mexican colonial and business cities such as Guanajuato, San Miguel de Allende and Puebla. Querétaro is a little cheaper than San Miguel de Allende and a little pricier than Puebla. The tourist-heavy historic centre costs more than outer neighbourhoods.
